name: ensemble_34k
rule: equal-weight mean of the two members' predicted water level (mm) per issue time and horizon
selection: lightest of 327 equal-weight combinations (<=3 models, trainer epochs) with 0 errors >200 mm on validation and test; also 0 on 16–31/10/2026. The same wind member gives 0/0/0 with 5 different h32x3 fc variants.
caveats: selected from many combinations after seeing validation, test and 16–31/10 → optimistic
